name: qlrisk_risk_report
title: Unified risk report
description: Every risk in one call with qlrisk's RiskEngine: PV, sensitivities (DV01/CS01/delta/vega), historical VaR and ES, parametric VaR, stressed VaR, the stress library, backtest, FRTB SA capital and counterparty exposure (peak PFE and SA-CCR EAD netted per netting set), rolled up a reporting hierarchy (VaR and ES are non-additive, recomputed per node), with optional limit checks. measures: PV, SENSITIVITIES, VAR, ES, PARAMETRIC_VAR, SVAR, STRESS, BACKTEST, FRTB_SA, EXPOSURE (default PV, SENSITIVITIES, VAR, ES, SVAR, STRESS, FRTB_SA, EXPOSURE). use_demo_book=true runs qlrisk's six-trade demo book (swap, bond, CDS, FX option, equity option, commodity forward) with its history, hierarchy and FRTB maps. Example: {"use_demo_book": true, "limits": [{"name": "Firm 1d VaR", "metric": "var.1d", "limit": 500000}]}.
